title: OEIS Learn Phase 3 CLI Interface Contract
description: Expanded CLI contract for Phase 3 inductive algorithmic generalization, demonstration co-training, anti-shortcut regularization, and fine-grained credit assignment

train.description: Train the policy using EGCA-GRPO with demonstration co-training, non-triviality gating, and potential-based reward shaping.

--sft-checkpoint.description: Path to warmed-up SFT checkpoint for initialization and reference KL penalty

--tier.description: Hardware tier (1 = local workstation, 2 = cluster scale-up)

--beta-kl.description: Schulman reference model KL divergence penalty weight

--alpha-ent.description: Policy token entropy regularization bonus weight

--enable-pbrs.description: Enable Potential-Based Reward Shaping over AST completion states

synthesize.description: Synthesize a WebAssembly algorithm with strict non-triviality verification and extrapolation testing.

--extrapolate.description: Number of future terms to verify (default 100)

--mdl-max.description: Maximum allowed Minimum Description Length ratio

discover.description: Run the self-supervised manifold discovery and PSLQ theorem verification pipeline with additive homomorphism constraints.

--checkpoint.description: Path to model checkpoint with Kernel VICReg embeddings

--max-candidates.description: Maximum number of candidate relations to verify

--precision-digits.description: Decimal precision digits for mpmath sampling

--output-proofs.description: Destination markdown file for verified symbolic proofs
